plan.summary: Lowers the export batch size from 2000 to 500 rows. Also removes a debug log, renames a local variable, and fixes a README typo.
plan.riskRationale: One constant change affects export batching. Smaller batches mean more batches but should not change output. The other edits are cosmetic.
plan.storyArc: The only behavioral change is the smaller BATCH_ROWS constant. The remaining hunks are cleanup and are left out as noise.
